notes.title: Linux version, new artwork and ui, configuration screen
notes.content:
Zia is now available for Linux users (and steam os), the user interface have been reworked, as well as the title and gameover screen with new awesome artwork!
There is a now a configuration screen to select game options such as fullscreen, gamepad/keyboard, sound volume.

notes.title: New artwork
notes.content: New artwork for title and gameover screen.
